headline: Tanzania Signs US$1.2 Billion Financing Facility for Railway Project
summary: Tanzania signed a US$1.2 billion bank facility for its 411 km Tabora-Kigoma railway, supported by an African Development Bank guarantee of up to US$800 million.
why: Large-scale sovereign infrastructure financing deals drive regional economic integration, transport capabilities, and capital project spending in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Tanzania
impacts.why: Sovereign funding for railway infrastructure supports domestic construction and transport logistics.
